description: M5 control for lrml at k=99999 (all labels): the external-data replay (cars_full_external / in_shop_full_external, 1000 epochs, patience 20, max-ratio cap as in those runs) with no external images. unlabeled_source='split' attaches no pool and the split leaves 0 unlabeled candidates. The tuned studies use graph_on='all' (global graph), so the LRML Laplacian term still runs, on a kNN graph over the labeled training images only; it is the external runs minus their external graph nodes, not an SSL-off run.
name: full_external_0_lrml
